title: Flow Matching with Uncertainty Quantification and Guidance
abstract: arXiv:2602.10326v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Despite the remarkable success of sampling-based generative models such as flow matching, they can still produce samples of inconsistent or degraded quality. To assess sample reliability and improve sample fidelity, we propose uncertainty-aware flow matching (UA-Flow), a lightweight extension of flow matching that predicts the velocity field together with heteroscedastic uncertainty. UA-Flow estimates spatially localized sample uncertainty by propagating velocity uncertainty through the flow dynamics. The resulting estimates serve as reliability signals that reflect data-manifold support for each generated sample or region. We further use them to steer generation via uncertainty-aware guidance (UG) and uncertainty-aware classifier-free guidance (UCFG). translated_title: 具有不确定性量化与引导的流匹配
translated_abstract: 尽管流匹配等基于采样的生成模型取得了显著成功，它们仍可能产生质量不一致或退化的样本。为了评估样本的可靠性并提高样本的保真度，我们提出了不确定性感知流匹配，这是流匹配的一个轻量级扩展，能够同时预测速度场和异方差不确定性。UA-Flow 通过在流动力学中传播速度不确定性来估计空间局部化的样本不确定性。所得的估计值可作为可靠性信号，反映数据流形对每个生成样本或区域的支持程度。我们进一步利用这些信号，通过不确定性感知引导（UG）和不确定性感知无分类器引导（UCFG）来引导生成过程。在 ImageNet 和 CIFAR-10 上的实验表明，UA-Flow 的不确定性比逐元素基线方法更能一致地跟踪样本保真度，并且这些信号还携带有价值的信息。
tldr: 提出了不确定性感知流匹配UA-Flow，通过预测速度场的异方差不确定性来量化生成样本的可靠性，并利用该信号实现不确定性感知引导，从而提升生成样本的保真度。
en_tdlr: We propose UA-Flow, an uncertainty-aware extension of flow matching that quantifies sample reliability via heteroscedastic velocity uncertainty and leverages these signals for uncertainty-aware guidance to improve sample fidelity.
